segments.text: For the past few tutorials, we've been looking at some different separation techniques that
segments.zh: 在前几期教程中，我们一直在了解几种不同的分离技术，

segments.text: we can perform in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 都是可以在实验室里进行的。

segments.text: These techniques separate the components of a mixture by taking advantage of differences
segments.zh: 这些技术利用混合物各组分在物理和化学性质上的差异

segments.text: in their physical and chemical properties.
segments.zh: 把它们分离开。

segments.text: Today we are going to look at another technique that is more of a purification technique.
segments.zh: 今天我们要看的另一种技术，更像是一种纯化技术。

segments.text: Sometimes when performing a chemical reaction, a solid will be produced.
segments.zh: 有时在进行化学反应时，会生成固体。

segments.text: We saw this occur when we performed an extraction, and while working with the aqueous layer, we
segments.zh: 我们在做萃取时就见过这种情况：在处理水层时，我们

segments.text: caused benzoic acid to precipitate.
segments.zh: 使苯甲酸沉淀了出来。

segments.text: We then separated this precipitate from the rest of the solution by using vacuum filtration.
segments.zh: 然后我们用减压抽滤把这些沉淀与溶液的其余部分分开。

segments.text: However, we did not discuss the fact that when a solid precipitates, it may incorporate
segments.zh: 不过，我们没有讨论这样一个事实：固体沉淀时，可能会把

segments.text: a number of impurities from solution into the lattice structure.
segments.zh: 溶液中的许多杂质带进晶格结构里。

segments.text: In order to separate the product from these impurities, or to purify the solid, we will
segments.zh: 为了把产物与这些杂质分开，也就是纯化固体，我们要

segments.text: perform something called recrystallization.
segments.zh: 进行一种叫做重结晶的操作。

segments.text: Recrystallization is a technique that takes advantage of the difference in solubility between
segments.zh: 重结晶是一种利用溶解度差异的技术，即

segments.text: our desired product and any impurities that may be present within.
segments.zh: 目标产物与其中可能存在的各种杂质之间的溶解度差异。

segments.text: The way this works is that we will be taking our impure product and dissolving it once
segments.zh: 它的原理是，我们把不纯的产物再次

segments.text: more in a hot solvent so that it will dissociate and release the impurities.
segments.zh: 溶解在热溶剂中，使其解离并释放出杂质。

segments.text: The solution is then cooled down, which causes our pure product to crystallize again, but
segments.zh: 然后让溶液冷却，这会使纯净的产物重新结晶，但

segments.text: this time the impurities remain dissolved in the solvent, because of their enhanced solubility
segments.zh: 这一次杂质仍然溶解在溶剂中，因为它们在该溶剂中的溶解度

segments.text: in that solvent over the product we are isolating.
segments.zh: 比我们要分离的产物更高。

segments.text: The solid will initially dissolve because of the higher temperature, since solubility
segments.zh: 固体一开始会因为温度较高而溶解，因为溶解度

segments.text: typically increases with temperature, but as it cools, solubility is reduced, until
segments.zh: 通常随温度升高而增大，但随着冷却，溶解度降低，直到

segments.text: it eventually crashes out of solution once more, this time with negligible impurity.
segments.zh: 它最终再次从溶液中析出，这一次杂质几乎可以忽略不计。

segments.text: To carry out a recrystallization, we will need a few materials.
segments.zh: 要进行重结晶，我们需要准备一些材料。

segments.text: First, we will need two beakers.
segments.zh: 首先，我们需要两个烧杯。

segments.text: We will use a 250 milliliter and a 150 milliliter beaker in this experiment.
segments.zh: 本实验中我们将使用一个 250 毫升和一个 150 毫升的烧杯。

segments.text: Then we will need a hot plate with a magnetic stirrer, or a Bunsen burner if a hot plate
segments.zh: 然后我们需要一台带磁力搅拌的加热板，如果没有加热板，

segments.text: is not available.
segments.zh: 也可以用本生灯。

segments.text: We will also need a stir bar, stirring rod, a vacuum filtration setup, a powder funnel,
segments.zh: 我们还需要一个搅拌子、一根玻璃棒、一套减压抽滤装置、一个粉末漏斗、

segments.text: a watch glass, and disposable pipettes.
segments.zh: 一块表面皿和一些一次性滴管。

segments.text: Lastly, we're going to need our product.
segments.zh: 最后，我们需要我们的产物。

segments.text: Remember, this is a technique that is typically applied in order to purify a solid product
segments.zh: 请记住，这项技术通常用于纯化

segments.text: that has been collected at the end of a chemical reaction.
segments.zh: 在化学反应结束时收集到的固体产物。

segments.text: In this case, we're going to use impure benzoic acid, as though we are continuing
segments.zh: 在这里，我们将使用不纯的苯甲酸，就好像我们在接着做

segments.text: the extraction we performed earlier in the series.
segments.zh: 本系列前面进行的萃取实验一样。

segments.text: And for the solvent, we will use distilled water.
segments.zh: 溶剂方面，我们将使用蒸馏水。

segments.text: Now choosing a suitable recrystallization solvent is the most important part of the experiment.
segments.zh: 选择合适的重结晶溶剂是这个实验中最重要的部分。

segments.text: We need our impurities to be soluble in our solvent at all temperatures.
segments.zh: 我们需要杂质在任何温度下都能溶于溶剂。

segments.text: They must dissolve as we heat things up, and remain dissolved when we cool it back down.
segments.zh: 升温时它们必须溶解，降温后也必须保持溶解。

segments.text: However, the product must only be soluble at high temperatures.
segments.zh: 然而，产物必须只在高温下可溶。

segments.text: It dissolves when we heat it up, but then precipitates again as we cool it back down.
segments.zh: 加热时它会溶解，但冷却后又会重新沉淀。

segments.text: To find an adequate solvent, we must look at tabulated solubility data, and compare
segments.zh: 要找到合适的溶剂，我们必须查阅溶解度数据表，比较

segments.text: the solubilities of our product in different solvents at different temperatures.
segments.zh: 产物在不同温度下、在不同溶剂中的溶解度。

segments.text: You can find this data online, since many different compounds and solvents have been
segments.zh: 你可以在网上找到这些数据，因为许多不同的化合物和溶剂都已经

segments.text: studied in this manner.
segments.zh: 以这种方式研究过了。

segments.text: In this case, a quick search will tell us that benzoic acid has a very high solubility
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，简单一查就会知道，苯甲酸在沸水中的溶解度

segments.text: in boiling water, 56.31 grams per liter, while it is very low in room temperature water,
segments.zh: 非常高，为每升 56.31 克，而在室温水中则非常低，

segments.text: only 3.44 grams per liter.
segments.zh: 每升只有 3.44 克。

segments.text: This makes water a good choice for our recrystallization solvent, and specifically distilled water,
segments.zh: 这使得水成为我们重结晶溶剂的良好选择，具体来说是蒸馏水，

segments.text: as we do not want to introduce additional impurities from tap water.
segments.zh: 因为我们不想从自来水中引入额外的杂质。

segments.text: We are ready to begin the recrystallization.
segments.zh: 我们可以开始重结晶了。

segments.text: We will start by heating up 150 milliliters of pure distilled water in a 250 milliliter
segments.zh: 首先，我们在加热板上用一个 250 毫升的烧杯加热

segments.text: beaker on a hot plate.
segments.zh: 150 毫升纯净的蒸馏水。

segments.text: As that heats up, let's weigh our impure product.
segments.zh: 在加热的同时，我们来称量不纯的产物。

segments.text: We're going to be using 3 grams of benzoic acid today.
segments.zh: 今天我们要用 3 克苯甲酸。

segments.text: Let's add the powder to a clean, dry, 150 milliliter beaker.
segments.zh: 把粉末加入一个干净、干燥的 150 毫升烧杯中。

segments.text: Once the water is sufficiently heated, we're going to use a disposable pipette to add
segments.zh: 水加热到足够温度后，我们用一次性滴管把

segments.text: hot water to our product.
segments.zh: 热水加到产物中。

segments.text: Based on the solubility of benzoic acid, it looks like we should add around 100 milliliters
segments.zh: 根据苯甲酸的溶解度，看起来我们应该向 3 克苯甲酸中加入大约 100 毫升

segments.text: of water to our 3 grams of benzoic acid to ensure that it will completely dissolve.
segments.zh: 水，以确保它能完全溶解。

segments.text: We can add a little bit of hot water at a time, slowly, until we can see that it
segments.zh: 我们可以每次加一点热水，慢慢加，直到看到它

segments.text: has fully dissolved.
segments.zh: 完全溶解。

segments.text: Add a stir bar to the solution and place it on the hot plate alongside the hot water beaker,
segments.zh: 往溶液中放入一个搅拌子，把它放在加热板上，挨着装热水的烧杯，

segments.text: so that you can keep heating and dissolving as you add more water.
segments.zh: 这样你就可以一边加水一边继续加热、溶解。

segments.text: While we do need the solid to dissolve completely, it is important to use the minimum amount of
segments.zh: 虽然我们确实需要固体完全溶解，但在重结晶过程中，使用尽可能少的

segments.text: solvent that is possible during a recrystallization.
segments.zh: 溶剂是很重要的。

segments.text: Do not add more solvent than is needed.
segments.zh: 不要加入超过所需量的溶剂。

segments.text: After everything is dissolved, remove the stirring rod and stir bar.
segments.zh: 全部溶解后，取出玻璃棒和搅拌子。

segments.text: Before you let the solution cool down to crystallize, check for any impurities that did not dissolve,
segments.zh: 在让溶液冷却结晶之前，检查是否有未溶解的杂质，

segments.text: as some impurities may be insoluble in your solvent at any temperature.
segments.zh: 因为有些杂质在任何温度下都可能不溶于你的溶剂。

segments.text: You will have to filter them out using vacuum or gravity filtration.
segments.zh: 你需要用减压过滤或常压过滤把它们滤掉。

segments.text: Make sure you do this immediately before the solution cools down, or you risk filtering
segments.zh: 一定要在溶液冷却之前立即进行，否则你可能会把

segments.text: away some of your product.
segments.zh: 一部分产物也滤掉。

segments.text: This is why we call this step hot filtration.
segments.zh: 这就是我们把这一步称为热过滤的原因。

segments.text: After you have made sure that your solution is clear, leave it at room temperature and
segments.zh: 确认溶液澄清后，把它放在室温下，

segments.text: cover it with a watch glass, allowing it to cool down slowly.
segments.zh: 盖上表面皿，让它慢慢冷却。

segments.text: The crystals should start to form relatively quickly, and as more cooling occurs, more
segments.zh: 晶体应该会比较快地开始形成，随着进一步冷却，会出现更多

segments.text: crystals will appear.
segments.zh: 晶体。

segments.text: Be patient and do not move or shake the beaker while the cooling is happening.
segments.zh: 要有耐心，冷却过程中不要移动或摇晃烧杯。

segments.text: To complete the recrystallization, you can move your beaker to an ice bath or a fridge
segments.zh: 为了完成重结晶，你可以把烧杯移到冰浴中或冰箱里

segments.text: for five minutes or so.
segments.zh: 放五分钟左右。

segments.text: This is to ensure that all our product has precipitated.
segments.zh: 这是为了确保所有产物都已沉淀出来。

segments.text: The impurities are now in the liquid solution, and these lovely crystals represent our pure
segments.zh: 现在杂质在液体溶液中，而这些漂亮的晶体就是我们的纯净

segments.text: product.
segments.zh: 产物。

segments.text: We're now going to separate the crystals from the liquid.
segments.zh: 现在我们要把晶体和液体分开。

segments.text: Use a stirring rod to mix the solution a bit so that we can pour it into the filter.
segments.zh: 用玻璃棒稍微搅动一下溶液，这样我们就能把它倒进过滤器里。

segments.text: We will be using our vacuum filtration setup, but gravity filtration is also possible.
segments.zh: 我们将使用减压抽滤装置，不过常压过滤也可以。

segments.text: Pour your solution into the Buchner funnel, and the crystals will be collected.
segments.zh: 把溶液倒入布氏漏斗，晶体就会被收集下来。

segments.text: It is important to pour more pure solvent over the crystals during filtration, as this will
segments.zh: 过滤时，往晶体上再倒一些纯溶剂很重要，因为这样可以

segments.text: wash your product, meaning that it will remove the original solvent since it contains impurities,
segments.zh: 洗涤产物，也就是除去原来的溶剂，因为原溶剂中含有杂质，

segments.text: and we don't want any of those sitting on our pure crystals.
segments.zh: 而我们不希望这些杂质残留在纯净的晶体上。

segments.text: We must wash them through the funnel.
segments.zh: 我们必须用漏斗把它们洗掉。

segments.text: After this, let the vacuum run for a few minutes to further dry your product.
segments.zh: 之后，让真空继续抽几分钟，进一步干燥产物。

segments.text: Your product should now be almost dry.
segments.zh: 现在你的产物应该差不多干了。

segments.text: You can leave it out to air dry at room temperature or put it in the oven.
segments.zh: 你可以把它放在室温下自然晾干，或者放进烘箱里。

segments.text: You have now completed a recrystallization.
segments.zh: 现在你已经完成了一次重结晶。

segments.text: Now the point of this technique was to get pure crystals.
segments.zh: 这项技术的目的是得到纯净的晶体。

segments.text: The best way to test the purity of a solid is by measuring its melting point and comparing
segments.zh: 检验固体纯度的最好方法是测量它的熔点，并将其

segments.text: it to the original impure mixture, as well as the literature value for the product.
segments.zh: 与原来的不纯混合物以及该产物的文献值进行比较。

segments.text: To perform melting point analysis, we need a melting point tube, and we need to insert
segments.zh: 要进行熔点分析，我们需要一根熔点管，并且要装入

segments.text: a tiny sample of our solid.
segments.zh: 一点点固体样品。

segments.text: We then need to use some mechanical force to get this sample to the bottom of the melting
segments.zh: 然后我们需要施加一些机械力，让样品落到熔点管的

segments.text: point tube.
segments.zh: 底部。

segments.text: Then we place it in the melting point apparatus, turn it on, and wait for the temperature
segments.zh: 然后把它放进熔点仪，打开仪器，等待温度

segments.text: to slowly approach the expected melting point range.
segments.zh: 慢慢接近预期的熔程。

segments.text: As it nears, begin to watch through the eyepiece.
segments.zh: 快到的时候，开始通过目镜观察。

segments.text: As soon as you see the first signs of melting, record the temperature.
segments.zh: 一看到最初的熔化迹象，就记录温度。

segments.text: Then the moment you see that all of the sample is completely melted, record the temperature
segments.zh: 然后在看到全部样品完全熔化的那一刻，再次记录

segments.text: again.
segments.zh: 温度。

segments.text: That is your melting point range.
segments.zh: 这就是你的熔程。

segments.text: The purified sample should give a melting point range that is much closer to the reported
segments.zh: 与不纯的粗品相比，纯化后的样品给出的熔程应该更加接近

segments.text: value when compared with the impure, crude sample.
segments.zh: 文献报道值。

segments.text: In addition, an impure solid will give a wide range during melting point analysis, meaning
segments.zh: 此外，不纯的固体在熔点分析中会给出较宽的熔程，也就是说

segments.text: it will start and finish melting several degrees apart or more.
segments.zh: 它开始熔化和熔化完全之间会相差好几度甚至更多。

segments.text: A highly pure solid will have a very sharp melting point, where all of it melts at a
segments.zh: 高纯度的固体熔点会非常敏锐，所有样品都会在

segments.text: particular temperature very rapidly.
segments.zh: 某个特定温度下迅速熔化。

segments.text: So the width of the range, together with a comparison to the tabulated melting point,
segments.zh: 所以熔程的宽度，再加上与熔点表数据的比较，

segments.text: will allow us to gauge the purity of the recrystallized product.
segments.zh: 可以让我们评估重结晶产物的纯度。

segments.text: Be sure to turn off the melting point apparatus when you are finished with it.
segments.zh: 用完熔点仪后，一定要把它关掉。

segments.text: We can also check the percent recovery of our sample by weighing the purified sample.
segments.zh: 我们还可以通过称量纯化后的样品来计算样品的回收率。

segments.text: Before the mass of the crystals recovered, we can divide this by the mass of the original
segments.zh: 得到回收晶体的质量后，我们可以用它除以原来

segments.text: sample and multiply by a hundred to get the percent recovery.
segments.zh: 样品的质量，再乘以一百，就得到回收率。

segments.text: During recrystallization we always lose a percentage of our sample, so expect for this value to
segments.zh: 在重结晶过程中，我们总会损失一部分样品，所以这个数值预计会

segments.text: be less than 100%.
This is due to the impurities which have been removed from the lattice, as well as some
segments.zh: 这是由于从晶格中除去了杂质，同时也有一些

segments.text: of the pure product which is lost in the process.
segments.zh: 纯产物在过程中损失了。

segments.text: There is one more thing to keep in mind.
segments.zh: 还有一件事需要记住。

segments.text: Sometimes your crystals will refuse to grow, even if you use an ice bath to cool them down
segments.zh: 有时候你的晶体就是不肯长出来，即使你用冰浴把它们冷却

segments.text: to a lower temperature.
segments.zh: 到更低的温度也不行。

segments.text: This can be caused by the glass surface in the beaker being too smooth.
segments.zh: 这可能是因为烧杯的玻璃表面太光滑了。

segments.text: One solution is to use a glass rod to scrape your beaker on the bottom and sides.
segments.zh: 一个解决办法是用玻璃棒刮擦烧杯的底部和侧壁。

segments.text: This will generate some loose glass particles upon which your crystals can grow.
segments.zh: 这会产生一些松散的玻璃颗粒，晶体可以在上面生长。

segments.text: Another good method to initiate crystallization is to add a few crystals of your pure product
segments.zh: 另一个引发结晶的好方法是，往溶液中加入几粒纯产物的晶体，

segments.text: to the solution so that other molecules can join an existing lattice.
segments.zh: 这样其他分子就可以加入已有的晶格。

segments.text: This is called using a seed crystal.
segments.zh: 这叫做使用晶种。

segments.text: In some more advanced recrystallizations, we may need to use multisolvent systems.
segments.zh: 在一些更高级的重结晶中，我们可能需要使用混合溶剂体系。

segments.text: In this case, this first solvent dissolves the impure product, while the addition of
segments.zh: 这种情况下，第一种溶剂溶解不纯的产物，而加入

segments.text: a second solvent causes the pure product to gradually crystallize.
segments.zh: 第二种溶剂会使纯产物逐渐结晶出来。

segments.text: But as that's a bit more advanced, this will be all for recrystallization.
segments.zh: 不过这部分稍微高级一些，所以关于重结晶就讲到这里。

segments.text: Let's move on to some other techniques.
segments.zh: 让我们继续学习其他一些技术。
